IT support plans

From a single remote session to ongoing support for a small team. Plan details are being finalized, so for now every plan starts with a short conversation and a written quote.

Ask about a planRequest one-time help

Plan options

Scope and pricing are not published yet

We will not show features, response windows, or prices until they are confirmed. Each plan below describes who it is for. Ask us and we will quote your situation in writing.

One-time support

For individuals and teams with a single problem to solve.

Quoted per request

Typical use
A software error, a slow computer, or a new device setup.

One-time support scope, session length, and response window (placeholder, not yet confirmed)

Business Essentials

For small offices that want regular check-ups and someone to call.

Pricing to be announced

Business Essentials devices covered, inclusions, exclusions, and response window (placeholder, not yet confirmed)

Business Plus

For growing teams with more devices, onboarding, and setup needs.

Pricing to be announced

Business Plus devices covered, inclusions, exclusions, and response window (placeholder, not yet confirmed)

Custom business support

For organizations whose needs do not fit a standard plan.

Quoted individually

Typical use
A mix of IT support, website care, and project work under one arrangement.
Scope and response
Agreed in writing for your organization.
Discuss your needs

What every plan will include

  • A written description of scope, inclusions, and exclusions
  • A stated response window for business hours
  • Remote sessions that start only with your permission
  • A clear process for work outside the plan, quoted before it starts

Support is not offered around the clock unless a plan explicitly says so.

Not sure which plan fits?

Tell us how many people and devices you support. We will recommend one-time help or a recurring arrangement.
